info.name: BrewMemo
info.summary: Fast note app with beautifully crafted mobile Apps
info.description:
BrewMemo is a fast note-taking app with beautifully designed mobile clients.
Your notes are stored securely in your Nextcloud, without any vendor lock-in.
The [iOS App](https://apps.apple.com/de/app/brewmemo/id6514303780?l=en-GB) is available *now* in the App Store, and the Android app will follow soon.
## Current features:
||Nextcloud|iOS| |-|-|-| |Markdown Editor|✅|✅| |WYSIWYG Editor|✅|✅| |Pinning and tagging of notes|soon|✅| |Different themes and color styles|planned|✅| |Export notes to PDF and TXT/Markdown|planned|✅| |and many more to come|||
